ChatMessage.title: Live Match Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A real-time chat message sent by an authenticated viewer in a live broadcast match room.

roomId.description: Sanitized identifier of the live broadcast room matching the parent document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Display name shown alongside the message.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile photo URL of the sender.

/match_rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageI.description: Real-time live match chat messages partitioned by broadcast room ID.
